```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)

corona_topology <- read_tsv("combi_out_ot/covid/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

hsv_topology <- read_tsv("combi_out_ot/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hiv_topology <- read_tsv("combi_out_ot/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

gprofile_reader <- function(type, path) {
  files <- list.files(
    path = path,
    pattern = paste0(type, "\\.sub_enriched_pathways\\.tsv$"),
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  transformed_names <- basename(files) %>%
    str_remove("\\.gprofiler2.*") %>%
    str_remove("\\.string_\\d+") %>%
    str_remove("\\.ppi_plus_virus_\\w+") %>%
    str_remove("\\.(\\w+)\\.\\1$") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\.", "_")
  datalist <- files %>%
    set_names(transformed_names) %>%
    map(~ read_tsv(.x))
  data_list_combi <- datalist %>% imap_dfr(~ .x %>% mutate(source = .y))
  return(data_list_combi)
}

corona_kegg_combi <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "combi_out_ot/covid/evaluation/gprofiler/")

hsv_kegg_combi <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "combi_out_ot/hsv/evaluation/gprofiler/")

hiv_kegg_combi <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "combi_out_ot/hiv/evaluation/gprofiler/")

corona_filter_kegg <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "filtered_outputs/corona/evaluation/gprofiler/")  %>%
    mutate(filter = str_extract(source, "same_n|top_50|top_100")) %>%
    mutate(source = str_remove_all(source, "_(same_n|top_50|top_100)"))

hiv_filter_kegg <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "filtered_outputs/hiv/evaluation/gprofiler/") %>%
    mutate(filter = str_extract(source, "same_n|top_50|top_100")) %>%
    mutate(source = str_remove_all(source, "_(same_n|top_50|top_100)"))

hsv_filter_kegg <- gprofile_reader("KEGG", "filtered_outputs/hsv/evaluation/gprofiler/") %>%
    mutate(filter = str_extract(source, "same_n|top_50|top_100")) %>%
    mutate(source = str_remove_all(source, "_(same_n|top_50|top_100)"))

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

hiv_hvidb_human_interactors <- read_tsv("data/out_hiv_hvidb/human_seeds_hvidb.txt", col_names = FALSE)
hiv_intact_human_interactors <- read_tsv("data/out_hiv_intact/human_seeds_intact.txt", col_names = FALSE)
```


```{r}

corona_topology <- corona_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))

hsv_topology <- hiv_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))

hiv_topology <- hiv_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))

```

```{r}
hsv_topology %>%
  mutate(
    group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = method,
    y = nodes,
    fill = group,
    shape = group
  )) +
  # lines connecting human/virus within each dataset
  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(dataset, method)),
    position = pd,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  # points dodged by dataset
  geom_point(
    position = pd,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    aes(group = dataset)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Seed/Dataset",
    labels = c(
      "human_hvidb" = "human, HVIDB",
      "human_intact" = "human, IntAct",
      "human_open_targets" = "human, open targets",
      "virus_hvidb" = "virus, HVIDB",
      "virus_intact" = "virus, IntAct"
    ),
    values = c(
      "human_hvidb" = "darkblue",
      "human_intact" = "lightblue",
      "virus_hvidb" = "darkblue",
      "virus_intact" = "lightblue",
      "human_open_targets" = "blue"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Seed/Dataset",
    labels = c(
      "human_hvidb" = "human, HVIDB",
      "human_intact" = "human, IntAct",
      "human_open_targets" = "human, open targets",
      "virus_hvidb" = "virus, HVIDB",
      "virus_intact" = "virus, IntAct"
    ),
    values = c(
      "human_hvidb" = 22,
      "human_intact" = 22,
      "human_open_targets" = 22,
      "virus_hvidb" = 24,
      "virus_intact" = 24
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave("plots/hsv_module.jpeg", width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r}
get_kegg_data <- function(dataset, pathway_code, filter = FALSE){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust", "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbour")
  dataset_pathway <- dataset %>%
    mutate(source = str_remove(source, "_uniprot")) %>%
    mutate(method = str_remove(source, "human_seeds_(hvidb|intact)\\_|virus_seeds_(hvidb|intact)\\_|\\w+_targets\\_")) %>%
    mutate(dataset = ifelse(str_detect(source, "hvidb"), "HVIDB", NA)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = ifelse(str_detect(source, "intact"), "IntAct", dataset)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = ifelse(str_detect(source, "targets"), "open targets", dataset)) %>%
    mutate(seed = ifelse(str_detect(source, "human_seeds"), "human int.", "viral int.")) %>%
    mutate(seed = ifelse(str_detect(source, "targets"), "open targets", seed)) %>%
    mutate(seed = ifelse(seed == "open targets", "open targets", paste(dataset, seed))) %>%
    filter(Pathway_code == pathway_code)
  
  if(!filter){
    full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(method = methods, seed = unique(dataset_pathway$seed))
    joiner = c("method", "seed")
  }else{
    full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(method = methods, 
                                   seed = unique(dataset_pathway$seed), 
                                   filter = unique(dataset_pathway$filter))
    joiner = c("method", "seed", "filter")
  }
  
  pathway_complete <- full_combos %>%
      left_join(dataset_pathway, by = joiner) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
      mutate(Padj = ifelse(Padj == 0, 1, Padj))
  
  return(pathway_complete)
}

```


```{r}
corona_pathway <- get_kegg_data(corona_kegg_combi, "KEGG:05171")

corona_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Fraction_DE, y = method, fill = (Padj < 0.01))) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  facet_grid(seed ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#C60C12", "FALSE" = "#F6656A"), name = "Padj < 0.01") + 
  labs(title = "Modules which identified SARS-CoV-2 disease pathway",
       x = "Enriched Fraction") + 
  theme_bw()

ggsave("plots/covid_pathway.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 7)

corona_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(Padj), y = method)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black", fill = "red") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -log10(0.01)), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(seed ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  labs(title = "Modules which identified SARS-CoV-2 disease pathway") + 
  theme_bw()
ggsave("plots/covid_padj.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 7)
```

```{r}
combined_pathway <- bind_rows(
  corona_pathway %>% mutate(virus = "SARS-CoV-2"),
  hsv_pathway    %>% mutate(virus = "HSV-1"),
  hiv_pathway    %>% mutate(virus = "HIV-1")
) %>%
  mutate(virus = factor(virus, levels = c("SARS-CoV-2", "HSV-1", "HIV-1")))

virus_colors <- c("SARS-CoV-2" = "#F6656A", "HSV-1" = "#31ABE8", "HIV-1" = "#00D100")

combined_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(Padj), y = method, fill = virus)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -log10(0.01)), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(seed ~ virus, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = virus_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Modules which identified viral disease pathways") + 
  theme_bw()
ggsave("plots/combined_padj.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 7)


combined_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Fraction_DE, y = method, fill = virus)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  facet_grid(seed ~ virus, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = virus_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Modules which identified viral disease pathways", x = "Enriched Fraction") + 
  theme_bw()

ggsave("plots/combined_pathway.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 7)
```
